name: 99SMART
recent: 99 Speed Mart 公布了截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，营收和净利均实现同比增长。公司宣布第二次中期股息每股2.25仙，并定于12月除息及派发。同期，EPF 持续增持公司股份至7.6%。
notable: 宣布第二次中期股息每股2.25仙，除息日为2026年12月1日，派发日为12月14日。
EPF 在近期系列交易中增持公司股份至7.6%。
公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收同比增长8.7%，净利同比增长16.3%。
risks: 季度营收和盈利低于市场预期。
分析指增长可能因增量效益减弱而放缓。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度，营收为 MYR 3,300,916,000，同比增长8.7%，环比增长7.3%；净利为 MYR 189,782,000，同比增长16.3%，环比增长15.8%；净利率为5.7%，高于上一季度的5.3%。

recent_en: 99 Speed Mart reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with both revenue and net profit growing year-on-year. The company declared a second interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share, with ex-date and payment scheduled in December. Meanwhile, EPF continued to increase its stake in the company to 7.6%.
notable_en: Declared a second interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share, with ex-date on 1 December 2026 and payment date on 14 December.
EPF increased its stake in the company to 7.6% through a series of recent transactions.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 8.7% year-on-year and net profit up 16.3% year-on-year.
risks_en: Quarterly revenue and earnings came in below market expectations.
Analysts noted that growth may moderate as incremental benefits taper off.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 3,300,916,000, up 8.7% year-on-year and 7.3% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 189,782,000, up 16.3% year-on-year and 15.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.7%, higher than 5.3% in the previous quarter.
